verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents an official Go library, tsnet, for embedding Tailscale inside a Go program, and points to infrastructure-as-code providers and webhooks for automating a tailnet. That is real first-party programmatic building support. However, the evidence shows only a single-language embedding library, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: official SDKs in other languages, a documented SDK/client for the management API, published API reference or spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
